in_hindi.long_meaning: पशुपाल (lord of animals) or गोपालजी (master of cows)

in_marathi.name: Gopalnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gopalnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gopalnath is a name derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Gopala’ meaning ‘protector of cows’ and ‘Nath’ meaning ‘lord’ or ‘master’. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology, particularly the stories of Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as a protector and caretaker of cows.
